description: Forward a message from one WhatsApp chat to another.

confirm.description: Consent gate — REQUIRED on every call. Pass false first: the tool then performs no action and returns a preview of exactly what would happen. Show that preview to the user, get their explicit approval, and only then call again with true to forward this message.

message_id.description: The WhatsApp message ID to forward

to_phone.description: Phone number to forward to (international format without +)

name: forward_message
